sampling.purpose: Fixed instrumented tails and request departure B3→B2→B1; not natural EOS, quality or speed

protocol_contents.admission: Each phase clears APC, requires q0 anchor cached_tokens=0, then admits all three requests together. A/B native greedy trajectories unforced; eager forced to A and actual pre-forcing logits recorded.

qualification.query_dtype: BF16 actual hook and metadata BF16; maybe_quant_query must not quantize Q
qualification.own_cache_reference: FP64 full causal attention over actual FP8 E4M3 bytes decoded by real per-layer K/V scales; complete private suffix and generated tail
qualification.reference_points: First pure decode step at each B=3,2,1 in full_A and eager_teacher, every selected layer, both TP ranks; 24 points/rank
qualification.native_LSE: XQA O-only does not expose LSE; reference finite check only, no native LSE accuracy claim
qualification.same_input_eager_vs_FULL: At full_A points run original official attention forward on same Q, actual quantized cache and metadata; no cache rewrite
qualification.cold_AA: Tokens/APC hits and batch/question/position sequences exact for full_A/full_B; each phase rank0 all36 finite logit keys required
qualification.logit_drift: max_abs, relativeL2, top1/margin, bitwise flag descriptive; no new quality/noninferiority threshold
qualification.eager_teacher: Exact A token trajectory, APC hits and scheduled step sequence; logits measured before forcing
qualification.APC: Verify all complete common pages alias and nonaligned common-prefix page stays request-private at qualification points
qualification.failure: Any assertion/runtime/timeout fails this unit-scale configuration; no retries, calibration or backend search

instrumentation.selected_layer_copies: Additional FULL graphs copy Q/output/current K/V into persistent buffers at attention boundaries, preventing intermediate-storage reuse; official attention math/cache updates retained
instrumentation.memory: Report all cache shapes/strides/payload, actual allocated blocks and memory peaks, additional graph allocation and persistent instrument bytes
instrumentation.timing: All engine/generate/check timings instrumented; no application speedup claim
instrumentation.FP8_vs_BF16: Different input precision; this own-cache numerical qualification does not certify BF16 quality equivalence
instrumentation.runtime_library_identity: Record actual loaded FlashInfer .so paths/hash and package/source identity; missing flashinfer-cubin package is recorded rather than assumed installed

CPU_validation.result: 1 passed; strided uint8 FP8 storage, nonidentity pages, variable partial tails, nonunit scales, chunked vs independent direct FP64 oracle, future-token perturbation
CPU_validation.independent_review: kernel agent read-only review; independently extracted reference passed five chunk sizes at 1e-14 with storage_offset and strided gaps; CUDA not initialized. All reported driver key-coverage/scale issues resolved before freeze.

confirmation.reason: The prior numerical and trajectory assertions completed and summary was written before deadline, but process teardown did not finish within 201 seconds. Observed engine initialization was 141.779 seconds. This explicit confirmation permits 240 seconds plus up to 15 seconds termination grace, without changing executable source, model, prompt, masks, scales, sampling or numerical thresholds.
confirmation.overall_pass_rule: All original numerical/trajectory assertions AND ledger exit_code=0 AND timed_out=false. Driver summary alone is insufficient.
confirmation.scope: Native precision execution qualification only; no task-quality or joint-mechanism claim.
